nodes.title: Pack voltage at the end of a flight, loaded
nodes.text: 4S pack at 3.4 V/cell under full-throttle load
nodes.basis: 4S 6500 130C late in the flight; same basis as the K09 review section (3.4 V/cell)

nodes.title: Cylinder drag coefficient 1.1
nodes.text: 22 mm tube in the slipstream, Re ~1.3e4 (subcritical)
nodes.basis: Hoerner, Fluid-Dynamic Drag, ch. 3: Cd 1.0-1.2 for 1e4 < Re < 2e5

nodes.title: Slipstream peak-to-mean dynamic pressure 1.3
nodes.text: A real prop loads its outer half: the tube sees about 1.3 x the mean slipstream dynamic pressure
nodes.basis: typical blade loading peak near 0.75 R; bounds the uniform-disk value from above

nodes.title: Fin trailing-edge thickness 10 mm
nodes.text: blunt fin TE base, two 4.8 mm foam-board layers
nodes.basis: params fins.material and fins.layers; D3 has not drawn the fin yet

nodes.title: Foot frontal area 30 x 30 mm
nodes.text: crushable printed foot on each fin TE tip, on the prop axis
nodes.basis: D5 has not drawn the foot; 6 g printed PETG cap

nodes.title: Shear-layer spreading 0.08
nodes.text: the slipstream edge mixing layer grows 0.08 m per metre downstream on each side
nodes.basis: plane mixing layer vorticity thickness growth ~0.16-0.18 dx at velocity ratio 0 (Brown and Roshko 1974); half toward each side

nodes.title: Pitot error limit 2 %
nodes.text: thrust-dependent airspeed error at the probe tip must stay within 2 % of true airspeed (a constant bias is removed by ARSPD_RATIO; a thrust-dependent one is not)
nodes.basis: B4 choice; ArduPilot airspeed calibration removes only a constant ratio

nodes.title: Vortex-ring onset at 0.28 v_h
nodes.text: vortex-ring state begins at a descent rate of about 0.28 times the hover induced velocity
nodes.basis: Leishman, Principles of Helicopter Aerodynamics 2nd ed., sec. 2.14: VRS boundary from about -0.28 v_h (onset) to -1.0 v_h; conservative lower edge

nodes.title: Pitot boom 80 mm ahead of the pod front at z 0.045 m
nodes.text: plug-in pitot boom on the pod nose, probe along body x, tip 80 mm ahead of the pod front face, 30 mm above the pod base
nodes.basis: B4 placement (CR-B4-05); D2 draws POD-006; the tip x follows pod.x_le_m if the pod moves

nodes.title: Fin effective aspect ratio doubles on the wing
nodes.text: the wing acts as an end plate at the fin root inside the slipstream
nodes.basis: image method for a plate ending on a wall

nodes.title: Proposed motor cant 3 deg
nodes.text: each motor tilted 3 deg tangentially (about the line from the aircraft x-axis to the motor) so its thrust adds yaw torque in the sense of its reaction torque
nodes.basis: B4 proposal; common multirotor practice for yaw authority; D3/F4 decide

nodes.note: abstract and a citing review read; full paper not read

nodes.title: APC data transcription check
nodes.equation: Ct' = T / (rho n^2 D^4) ; Cp' = P / (rho n^3 D^5) from the printed N and W ; error = max |Ct'/Ct - 1|, |Cp'/Cp - 1| over rows with Ct, Cp >= 0.02 (4-digit rounding < 0.25 %)

nodes.title: Static operating points, five candidate props
nodes.equation: hover: T_h = k_dl m g / 4 -> rpm, P_shaft from Ct, Cp ; FM = T^1.5 / sqrt(2 rho A) / P_shaft ; full throttle: (V - rpm/Kv)/R = Q/Kt + I0 (E1 constants, hot winding) ; T/W (bus held, no current limit) = 4 T_max / (k_dl m g) ; rpm limit = K / D_in (APC)

nodes.title: Cruise operating point, five props, all four motors running
nodes.equation: T = m g / (L/D) / 4 ; solve rpm: Ct(J) rho n^2 D^4 = T at V ; eta_p = T V / P_shaft ; P_in = (rpm/Kv + I R) I + P_esc (E1 constants, 25 degC winding) ; total = 4 P_in

nodes.title: Hover download on tube, half-fins, feet and the wing beside the disc
nodes.equation: v_i = sqrt(T / 2 rho A) ; v(x) = v_i (1 + x / sqrt(x^2 + R^2)) ; r_s = R / sqrt(v/v_i) ; D = Cd q d L (tube) + 2 Cf q S (fin) + 0.5 q t h (fin base) + q A (foot) + D_wing ; wing: reach(x) = r_s + mix (x - x_p) ; gap(x) = z_m - reach - z_surf(x) (S5010 upper, and lower for the lower discs) ; where gap < 0 the wetted strip w = 2 sqrt(reach^2 - (z_m - z_surf)^2) carries Cf q/3 (mixing-layer mean of u^2) ; k = 1 + D/T

nodes.title: Slipstream edge versus elevons and wing
nodes.equation: hover: inner edge z = z_m - r_s(x) - mix (x - x_p) ; elevon tip z = c_e sin(delta_max) ; cruise: r_s ~ R (lightly loaded) ; gap = edge - surface

nodes.title: Prop-induced airspeed error at pitot candidates
nodes.equation: v from T = 2 rho A v (V + v) ; four semi-infinite vortex cylinders, gamma = 2 v ; u_x = integral of ring velocities (elliptic K, E) ; error = u_x / V ; grid: Simpson N = 100/200/400, wake length 20/40/80 R

nodes.title: Fin swirl recovery and hover yaw authority
nodes.equation: Gamma_s = Q / (rho v_i pi (R^2 - r_h^2)) ; v_t = Gamma_s / r ; alpha = atan(v_t / v_a) ; CL = 2 pi AR alpha / (2 + sqrt(AR^2 + 4)) (Helmbold) ; M = CL q c h r_cp ; f = M / Q ; yaw per N of differential thrust = (Q/T)(1 - f) + r_arm sin(cant) ; half-fin root moment = F (z_m - r_cp - z_root), z_root = mean S5010 surface over the fin chord

nodes.title: Prop spacing, descent limit, ground effect and tones
nodes.equation: gap_v = 2 z_m - D ; gap_l = 2 y_m - D ; v_h = sqrt(k m g / (8 rho A)) ; V_d,max = 0.28 v_h ; T_IGE/T = 1 / (1 - (R / 4 h)^2) ; M_tip = pi D n / a ; BPF = 2 n

nodes.title: UIUC-measured cross-check of the APC predictions
nodes.equation: static: Ct_UIUC / Ct_APC and Cp_UIUC / Cp_APC at J = 0, top measured rpm ; FM ratio = (Ct ratio)^1.5 / Cp ratio ; cruise: solve Ct_UIUC(J) rho n^2 D^4 = T at V ; eta = T V / P

nodes.title: Unlimited full-throttle rpm on a fresh pack and the output cap that respects the APC limit
nodes.equation: (V - rpm/Kv)/R = Q(rpm)/Kt + I0, cold winding (lowest R, highest rpm), V = max OCV ; cap: find V_eff giving rpm = 0.98 x 105000/D_in ; duty = V_eff / V_ocv,max ; T/W at the cap = 4 T(rpm_cap) / (k_dl m g)
